theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Euclid (n + 1) → Euclid P) (S : Set (Euclid (n + 1))), MeasurableSet S → (∀ w ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w) → (∀ w ∈ S, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) → InjOn Φ S → ∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun t : ℝ => ∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∫⁻ t : ℝ, (∫⁻ x in Φ '' (S ∩ {w | w 0 = t}), φ x ∂μHE[n]) = ∫⁻ w in S, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single i.succ 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ w (EuclideanSpace.single j.succ 1))))) * φ (Φ w) ∂volume
